description:
Verso: Accounts in Arabic and Greek/Coptic numerals. Detailing sums collected from various people (Maḥfūḍ, Bū l-ʿIzz al-Sharābī, Hilāl, Makkī(?)). Also detailing what is owed by Bū l-Faraj and others. 

Recto: There is a list of Coptic numerals of unclear significance. At 90 degrees, there are two lines in Judaeo-Arabic: "I took an oath not to break my fast on Sunday in the town. And peace." (חלפת מא אפטר יום אלאחד פי אלבלד ושלום)
